confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of South Korean price levels; no live listings or booking pages were consulted. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most reliable. Accommodation is least certain because July is peak beach season, when rates vary widely. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from their local price relationship to draft beer because direct knowledge is weaker. FX came from a web search summary citing the RBA exchange-rates table; the RBA page was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is South Korean regional price levels, with Busan priced below Seoul and a July peak-season premium applied to beach-area accommodation.
